metadata.note: Deepseek cleaned with aggressive deduplication (±50 char threshold)

key_findings.convergence: Deepseek and CAMeL-BERT both detect exactly 26 narrative units
key_findings.significance: Two independent ML approaches (LLM + Text Search vs Token Classification) converge on same granularity
key_findings.interpretation: Validates unit granularity represents true narrative boundaries
key_findings.baseline_behavior: Over-segments to 63 units, likely detecting individual isnads separately

deepseek_vs_baseline.description: Deepseek boundaries mostly found in Baseline, but Baseline has many additional boundaries

camelbert_vs_baseline.description: Similar to Deepseek vs Baseline - Baseline over-segments

outliers.explanation: Different granularity within multi-isnad passage - both agree there's boundary, different positioning

recommendations.primary_rationale: ML-based, learned from training data, excellent agreement with Deepseek, local computation
recommendations.secondary_rationale: LLM validation, zero-shot capable, identical granularity to CAMeL-BERT
recommendations.reference_rationale: Over-segments but useful for linguistic structure analysis and individual isnad detection

production_deployment.unit_characteristics: Coherent historical narratives with complete isnad chains
production_deployment.validation: Cross-check with Deepseek on subset for consistency
